title: Answer: the papers state no account of what consciousness is

statements.text: Chronoflux takes no position on what consciousness is. Its descendancy carries continuity through continuum behavior, quantum coherence, fields, matter, chemistry and biology, gravitation, cosmology and observation, with no branch for mind. Matter is the furthest it goes: conserved continuity organized strongly enough to keep a local physical identity, never an added primitive substance.
statements.scope: a reading of the papers cited in this folder, July 2026 and earlier
